name: Mamiya Miho
source:
A third-year student in the College of Education.
She has a serious and easygoing personality.
She and her boyfriend, Kento, have known each other since childhood, and their relationship developed naturally.
Lately, she’s been feeling a bit dissatisfied with their physical relationship, but she’s too shy to bring it up.
Her hobbies are cooking and reading.
